description: Start a recording session: launches a themed headless browser and begins capturing video. Returns the session config and the output directory. One session at a time — studio_finish or studio_cancel ends it. Set theme to the PRODUCT'S brand (bg = its app background — wrong bg causes visible flashes on page loads); use storage_state_path (a Playwright storageState JSON) to record logged-in areas without sharing credentials; list chat widgets / dev overlays / consent banners in hide_selectors so they never appear on tape.

cookies.description: Cookies to pre-set, e.g. your consent cookie so banners never mount (optional).

hide_selectors.description: CSS selectors to hide from frame 1 (chat bubbles, cookie banners, dev overlays).

show_cursor.description: Visible on-screen cursor that glides to targets (default true).

storage_state_path.description: Path to a Playwright storageState JSON for logged-in recording (optional).

theme.description: Visual theme for overlays/transitions — use the recorded product's brand.

brand.description: Brand name on transition cards; null for none.

name: studio_start
